name_story.story: Aeisha can be understood through the Arabic form عائشة, whose central sense is lady of the house. Variant romanization of عائشة. The source record's gloss 'Lady of the house' is unsupported.

faq.a: Aeisha is associated with the Arabic form عائشة, whose core sense is lady of the house.

faq.q: What is the origin of Aeisha?
faq.a: Aeisha is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of عائشة. The source record's gloss 'Lady of the house' is unsupported.
Yes — the underlying form عائشة is Arabic.
Aeisha can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aeisha should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. عائشة is not a Qur'anic form; it is the name of ʿĀʾisha bint Abī Bakr in the hadith and sīra tradition

faq.q: What does Aeisha mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Aeisha is rendered عائشہ and carries the sense گھر کی خاتون.

faq.q: What does Aeisha mean in Persian?
faq.a: No verified Persian form was established for Aeisha.
A romanized syllable approximation is aeis-ha. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Aeisha?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Aeisha, aeisha. Script forms are عائشة, عائشہ, عايشه, आयशा.

faq.q: Is Aeisha a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
